lessons.title: Duchy tenants may have to buy farms or leave as Prince William plans sell-off
lessons.title_zh: 威廉王子計畫出售資產，康沃爾公爵領地佃農可能必須買下農場或離開

paragraphs.en: Prince William, the Prince of Wales, intends to sell up to 20 percent of the historic Duchy of Cornwall during the coming ten years. The royal estate hopes to raise 500 million pounds from these sales to invest in affordable housing, environmental projects, and local communities. However, this major decision means that numerous tenant farmers across England might have to buy their land or move elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯親王威廉王子計畫在未來十年間出售歷史悠久的康沃爾公爵領地高達百分之二十的資產。該王室領地希望從這些出售案中籌得五億英鎊，以投資平價住宅、環境專案以及在地社區。然而，這項重大決定意味著英格蘭各地的許多佃農可能必須買下自己租賃的土地，或者遷往他處。

paragraphs.en: The Tenant Farmers Association (TFA) reported that up to 40 holdings in Devon, Cornwall, Herefordshire, and the Midlands might be impacted. In Devon, discussions regarding nine farms on the Bradninch estate have already triggered considerable worry. Mary Ryan, a local councillor and former general practitioner (GP), said several residents are suffering severe emotional distress because they cannot afford the purchase costs.
paragraphs.zh: 佃農協會（TFA）指出，德文郡、康沃爾郡、赫里福德郡以及中部地區高達四十處的農場物業可能受到影響。在德文郡，關於布拉德寧奇莊園內九處農場的協商，已經引發了相當嚴重的擔憂。身為當地議員且曾任全科醫師（GP）的瑪麗．萊恩（Mary Ryan）表示，數名居民正面臨劇烈的情緒痛苦，因為他們無力負擔高昂的購買費用。

paragraphs.en: Originally established in 1337, the Duchy oversees about 700 agricultural leases, including 300 full farm properties. George Dunn, the chief executive of the TFA, explained that poor communication has created prolonged uncertainty for families concerning valuations and available options. He stressed that authorities must explore fair alternatives for tenants who cannot afford to purchase the land.
paragraphs.zh: 康沃爾公爵領地最初於1337年創立，目前管理約七百處農業租約，其中包含三百處完整的農場物業。佃農協會執行長喬治．鄧恩（George Dunn）解釋，不良的溝通已導致許多家庭在資產估價與現有選擇方面，面臨長期存在的不確定性。他強調，相關單位必須為那些無力購買土地的佃農尋求公平的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Representatives from the Duchy stated that they are helping tenants with care and respect on a case-by-case basis. Matthew Morris, the rural director of the Duchy, noted that mental health support is being offered and stated there were "no cliff edges here" regarding quick evictions. He explained that the main objective is selling to current farmers, enabling some families to fulfill a generational dream of land ownership.
paragraphs.zh: 公爵領地的代表們表示，他們正以關懷與尊重的態度，個別審視每位佃農的情況並提供協助。公爵領地的鄉村事務總監馬修．莫里斯（Matthew Morris）指出，領地正向農民提供心理健康支援，並表示就快速驅離而言「這裡沒有斷崖式危機」。他解釋，主要目標是將土地售予現有農民，讓部分家庭得以實現世代傳承的擁有土地夢想。

phrases.zh: 按個別情況；視個案而定

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to invest... 是不定詞片語，用來說明王室籌措五億英鎊的具體目的。
grammar.example: The royal estate hopes to raise 500 million pounds from these sales to invest in affordable housing, environmental projects, and local communities.
grammar.focus: to invest in affordable housing, environmental projects, and local communities

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Adjective Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 在子句中擔任主詞，修飾先行詞 tenants，說明是「買不起土地的佃農」。
grammar.example: He stressed that authorities must explore fair alternatives for tenants who cannot afford to purchase the land.
grammar.focus: who cannot afford to purchase the land

grammar.explain: 過去分詞片語省略了連接詞與主詞，用以表示被動背景 (Because it was originally established...)，修飾主要子句的主詞 the Duchy。
grammar.example: Originally established in 1337, the Duchy oversees about 700 agricultural leases, including 300 full farm properties.

lessons.title: China conducting ‘area denial’ drills
lessons.title_zh: 中國進行「區域拒止」演習

paragraphs.en: Minister of National Defense Wellington Koo confirmed that China is carrying out "area denial" military exercises in the Western Pacific. These drills involve the Liaoning aircraft carrier group and other naval formations. Recently, National Security Council Secretary-General Joseph Wu revealed that more than 100 Chinese naval and coast guard ships were active around Taiwan, the South China Sea, and into the Pacific, while Chinese air activity also increased significantly.
paragraphs.zh: 國防部長顧立雄證實，中國正在西太平洋進行「區域拒止」軍事演習。這些演習涉及遼寧號航空母艦戰鬥群及其他海軍編隊。近日，國家安全會議秘書長吳釗燮透露，有一百多艘中國海軍及海巡艦艇在台灣周邊、南海及太平洋活動，而中國軍機的活動也大幅增加。

paragraphs.en: Anti-access and area denial, known as A2AD, aims to prevent outside allies from intervening if Beijing attacks Taiwan. While China described the drills as routine open-ocean combat capability tests, think tanks warned that China might be simulating the isolation of Taiwan with forces from three theater commands. These operations come before the APEC summit in Shenzhen and Taiwan's local elections.
paragraphs.zh: 反介入與區域拒止（簡稱 A2AD）旨在防止外部盟友在中共發動攻擊時介入援助台灣。儘管中國稱這些演習是常規的遠海作戰能力測試，但智庫警告中國可能正動用三個戰區的部隊模擬封鎖台灣。這些行動發生在深圳的亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）峰會以及台灣地方選舉之前。

paragraphs.en: Koo stated that Taiwan's armed forces are keeping a close watch on the situation with advanced surveillance systems and intelligence sharing. He warned that this deterrence was intended to "undermine peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific region." Furthermore, to prevent Chinese infiltration into sensitive high-tech and defense research sectors, the ministry is strengthening personnel security clearances and strictly enforcing national information protection laws.
paragraphs.zh: 顧立雄表示，台灣國軍正透過先進的偵察系統與情資交換密切關注局勢。他警告說，這種軍事威懾旨在「破壞印太地區的和平與穩定」。此外，為了防止中國滲透到敏感的高科技與國防研發領域，國防部正在加強人員安全查核，並嚴格執行國家機密保護法規。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, regional tensions have sparked diplomatic and domestic challenges. Taiwan decided to close its representative office in Papua New Guinea because of Chinese pressure. Authorities also deported a Chinese asylum seeker who arrived in Taiwan via Thailand. Additionally, following heavy stock market fluctuations where the TAIEX plunged sharply, the Taiwanese government authorized the activation of the National Stabilization Fund to prop up local shares.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，區域緊張局勢也引發了外交與國內挑戰。由於中國施壓，台灣決定關閉駐巴布亞紐幾內亞的代表處。當局也遣返了一名經由泰國抵達台灣尋求庇護的中國籍人士。此外，在加權指數大幅重挫引發股市劇烈波動後，台灣政府核准啟動國家金融安定基金以支撐本地股市。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語「to prevent...」置於句首，表示國防部加強人員查核與執法的「目的」。
grammar.example: Furthermore, to prevent Chinese infiltration into sensitive high-tech and defense research sectors, the ministry is strengthening personnel security clearances and strictly enforcing national information protection laws.

grammar.point: 動名詞當介系詞受詞 (Gerund as Object of Preposition)
grammar.explain: 介系詞「from」後面接動名詞「intervening」，構成「prevent... from + V-ing」（防止某人做某事）的固定用法。
grammar.example: Anti-access and area denial, known as A2AD, aims to prevent outside allies from intervening if Beijing attacks Taiwan.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「who」在子句中作主詞，用來修飾前面的先行詞「a Chinese asylum seeker」。
grammar.example: Authorities also deported a Chinese asylum seeker who arrived in Taiwan via Thailand.
grammar.focus: who arrived in Taiwan via Thailand

lessons.title: Testing the new generation of AI-enabled fire-extinguishing drones
lessons.title_zh: 測試具備人工智慧功能的新一代滅火無人機

paragraphs.en: In the mountains of Colorado, firefighters in Aspen are learning to operate a new type of drone designed to fight wildfires. Created by a California company named Seneca, these large black-and-white machines look like giant insects and are about the size of a small trailer. While drones have monitored fires for decades, these new devices use artificial intelligence to help extinguish them. When the program officially begins, Aspen could become the first fire department in the world to fly them independently.
paragraphs.zh: 在科羅拉多州的山區，阿斯彭（Aspen）的消防員正在學習操作一種專為撲滅野火而設計的新型無人機。這些黑白相間的大型機器由一家名為塞內卡（Seneca）的加州公司製造，外觀就像巨大的昆蟲，大小約莫相當於一輛小型拖車。雖然消防員使用無人機監測火災已有數十年之久，但這些新裝置利用人工智慧來協助撲滅火勢。當該計畫正式展開時，阿斯彭可能會成為全球第一個獨立操作這些無人機的消防部門。

paragraphs.en: The drones are built to work together in groups. Five of them can transport hundreds of gallons of fire-suppressing foam to remote locations that are hard for humans to reach, such as areas hit by lightning. According to Seneca's founder, Stuart Landesberg, an onboard system powered by artificial intelligence can measure wind speed and distance. It then drops water or flame retardant at the right angle and speed to put out lingering flames at a much lower cost than helicopters.
paragraphs.zh: 這些無人機被設計成能夠成群協同作業。五架無人機就能運送數百加侖的滅火泡沫到人類難以到達的偏遠地點，例如遭受雷擊的區域。根據塞內卡創辦人史都華・蘭德斯伯格（Stuart Landesberg）的說法，一個由人工智慧支援的機載系統能夠測量風速與距離。接著，它會以適當的角度和速度投放水或阻燃劑來撲滅殘存的火苗，而成本遠低於直升機。

paragraphs.en: Aspen Fire plans to spend about 2.5 million dollars over five years, funded by private donors. However, some experienced firefighters urge caution. Joe Stutler, a veteran firefighter with nearly six decades of experience, likes the idea of using drones at night when regular aircraft cannot fly. Still, he remains skeptical because the drones have only been tested during controlled burns, not on real wildfires. "I haven't seen any results," he noted, asking for solid data before celebrating.
paragraphs.zh: 阿斯彭消防局計劃在未來五年花費約兩百五十萬美元，費用由民間捐款者資助。然而，一些經驗豐富的消防員呼籲保持謹慎。擁有近六十年經驗的資深消防員喬・斯圖特勒（Joe Stutler）很認同在一般常規飛機無法飛行的夜間使用無人機的想法。儘管如此，他仍持懷疑態度，因為這些無人機只在計畫性引火燃燒中測試過，尚未應用於真正的野火。「我還沒看到任何結果，」他指出，並要求在慶祝前先拿出確切的資料。

paragraphs.en: Safety rules are also strict. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) recently granted a waiver allowing Aspen Fire to fly the drones up to 200 feet in Pitkin County. Firefighters cannot fly them over crowded neighborhoods, and an observer must watch the drones at all times. If this experimental project succeeds, local officials hope to expand their permit and assist in fighting fires across the state.
paragraphs.zh: 安全法規也相當嚴格。美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）最近核准了一項豁免，允許阿斯彭消防局在皮特金郡（Pitkin County）將無人機飛行至兩百英尺高。消防員不能讓無人機飛越人口稠密的社區，且必須始終有人監控無人機。如果這項實驗性計畫成功，地方官員希望能擴大許可範圍，並協助撲滅全州各地的火災。

grammar.explain: 句首使用過去分詞片語形成分詞構句，省略了連接詞與主詞，修飾主要子句的主詞 these large black-and-white machines。
grammar.example: Created by a California company named Seneca, these large black-and-white machines look like giant insects and are about the size of a small trailer.
grammar.focus: Created by a California company named Seneca

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to help 引導的不定詞片語用來說明主要動詞 use 的目的，回答「為了做什麼」。
grammar.example: While drones have monitored fires for decades, these new devices use artificial intelligence to help extinguish them.

grammar.explain: 關係副詞 when 在此引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的先行詞時間名詞 night。
grammar.example: Joe Stutler, a veteran firefighter with nearly six decades of experience, likes the idea of using drones at night when regular aircraft cannot fly.

lessons.title: Jimmy Carter’s Georgia farm acquired by conservation group planning to open it to public
lessons.title_zh: 吉米．卡特位於喬治亞州的農場獲保育團體收購，計畫向大眾開放

paragraphs.en: A non-profit environmental group called the Conservation Fund has acquired the family farm of former US president Jimmy Carter. The property covers about 2,458 acres near Plains, Georgia, and was bought for 8.5 million dollars. Officials plan to open the area to the public as early as 2027 for outdoor activities like fishing and hunting. In 2028, the group intends to transfer the land to Georgia's natural resources department.
paragraphs.zh: 一個名為「保育基金」（The Conservation Fund）的非營利環保團體收購了前美國總統吉米．卡特（Jimmy Carter）的家族農場。這處資產位於喬治亞州平原鎮（Plains）附近，佔地約 2,458 英畝，以 850 萬美元買下。官員計畫最早於 2027 年向大眾開放該地區，提供釣魚和打獵等戶外活動。在 2028 年，該團體打算將這片土地移交給喬治亞州的自然資源部。

paragraphs.en: The farm will eventually become part of the Lanahassee Creek wildlife management area, expanding it to almost 7,000 acres. This land is separate from Carter's boyhood home, which is already preserved by the US national park service. The farm provides a safe habitat for rare freshwater mussels in nearby creeks and tortoises that conservationists are trying to protect from becoming endangered. Carter himself had helped restore the forest by planting young longleaf pine trees.
paragraphs.zh: 該農場最終將成為拉納哈西溪（Lanahassee Creek）野生動物管理區的一部分，將其擴大至近 7,000 英畝。這片土地與卡特的童年故居分開，後者已由美國國家公園管理局保存。該農場為附近溪流中罕見的淡水貽貝以及保育人士極力防止瀕臨滅絕的陸龜提供了安全的棲息地。卡特本人曾藉由種植長葉松幼樹，協助復育這片森林。

paragraphs.en: Growing up on the farm shaped Carter’s strong conservation values. As a boy, he worked with his father growing peanuts, corn, and sugarcane. Throughout his life, he frequently returned to walk with his wife Rosalynn and fish in the pond. His grandson, Jason Carter, described the property as "a place my grandparents treasured" and expressed gratitude for its permanent protection.
paragraphs.zh: 在農場長大的經歷形塑了卡特深厚的保育價值觀。小時候，他與父親一起種植花生、玉米和甘蔗。在他的一生中，他經常回來與妻子羅莎琳（Rosalynn）散步，並在池塘釣魚。他的孫子傑森．卡特（Jason Carter）形容這處資產是「我祖父母珍視的地方」，並對其獲得永久保護表達感激。

paragraphs.en: Carter’s love for nature influenced his political decisions as president from 1977 to 1981. In late 1980, he signed the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act, which protected more than 104 million acres. He also created 39 units in the national park system, including historic and recreation sites in Georgia.
paragraphs.zh: 卡特對大自然的熱愛影響了他在 1977 年至 1981 年擔任總統期間的政治決策。在 1980 年底，他簽署了《阿拉斯加國家利益土地保育法案》，保護了超過 1.04 億英畝的土地。他還在國家公園系統中建立了 39 個單位，包括位於喬治亞州的歷史與休閒園區。

paragraphs.en: Before serving as president, Carter was the governor of Georgia. Although he lost the 1980 election to Ronald Reagan, he later earned the 2002 Nobel Peace Prize for his global humanitarian efforts. Carter passed away at the age of 100 in December 2024, leaving behind an enduring legacy of environmental protection.
paragraphs.zh: 在擔任總統之前，卡特曾任喬治亞州州長。雖然他在 1980 年的選舉中敗給了隆納．雷根（Ronald Reagan），但他後來因其全球人道主義工作的努力而獲得 2002 年諾貝爾和平獎。卡特於 2024 年 12 月以 100 歲高齡逝世，留下了長遠的環境保護遺產。

grammar.explain: 由「be 動詞 was + 過去分詞 bought」構成過去式被動語態，表示該農場「被以」八百五十萬美元購買。
grammar.example: The property covers about 2,458 acres near Plains, Georgia, and was bought for 8.5 million dollars.

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後的關係代名詞 which 指涉先行詞 Carter's boyhood home，用以補充說明該故居目前的保存狀態。
grammar.example: This land is separate from Carter's boyhood home, which is already preserved by the US national park service.

grammar.point: 動名詞當主詞 (Gerund as Subject)
grammar.explain: 動名詞片語 Growing up on the farm 置於句首擔任主要子句的主詞，視為單數概念。
grammar.example: Growing up on the farm shaped Carter’s strong conservation values.
